modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.
injury.detail: Smith was spotted at practice Friday, per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network. With the big man expected to play, fewer minutes will be on the table for Nic Claxton at center Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.
injury.detail: Black is a candidate to miss the first half of this back-to-back set. Tristan da Silva would likely enter the starting lineup for the Magic on Saturday if Black sits out.

injury.shortComment: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.
injury.detail: Wade was added to the injury report earlier Friday due to injury management of a hamstring problem, and in the end, the forward has been ruled out. This poses a problem for the 76ers, as Jaylen Brown (hamstring) is out as well. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope could be in line for a bigger role because of the absences. Wade's next chance to play will come Saturday against the Rockets on the second leg of a back-to-back set.

injury.shortComment: Giddey is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Pacers due to right ankle soreness, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: It's unclear when Giddey tweaked his ankle, given that the Bulls' last game took place Wednesday in what was a 107-105 win over the Hornets. His late addition to the injury report isn't a great sign, but Giddey's official status may not be known until closer to Saturday's 8:00 p.m. ET tipoff. Tre Jones would be the top candidate to enter Chicago's starting five if Giddey doesn't play against Indiana.

injury.shortComment: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.
injury.detail: Jakucionis will miss his second game of the season due to left ankle tenosynovitis. In his absence, Ryan Rollins, Caris LeVert and AJ Green could see expanded roles, while rookie Brayden Burries should also get a slight bump in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Essengue should be able to play through a thumb sprain Saturday. He hasn't logged more than 15 minutes in any of his last 12 appearances, leaving Essengue with limited fantasy appeal.
